title: NRM bundle
description:
A set of NRM records exchanged as one document. This is the interchange unit: what a team exports, what an import consumes, and what a fixture is.

A container rather than an entity. It exists because records reference each other by ID, so a Port sent without its Resource is unvalidatable -- referential checks need the whole set in hand. Sending entities as separate files makes that impossible to enforce and makes a partial import look successful.

`nrm_version` is on the bundle, not on each record, because the plan versions the contract as a whole. A bundle mixing versions is refused rather than partially interpreted.

nrm_version.description: Contract version this bundle conforms to. Required and exact: a consumer that guesses the version will misread a field that changed meaning, and it will do so silently.

generated_by.description: Tool and version that produced this. `nvis-rack-status 1.4.2` is useful when a bundle turns out to be wrong in a systematic way.

observation.description: Default for records that do not state their own. A bundle exported from a cabling plan sets `expected` once here rather than on every record.
